interpretations: For tracks with `Bytes > 10,323,804`, calculate `AVG(Bytes ÷ Milliseconds)` for each media type name, then take the simple average of those media type averages.
For tracks with `Bytes >= 10,323,804`, calculate `AVG(Bytes ÷ Milliseconds)` for each media type name, then take the simple average of those media type averages.
For tracks with `Bytes < 10,323,804`, calculate `AVG(Bytes ÷ Milliseconds)` for each media type name, then take the simple average of those media type averages.
For tracks with `Bytes <= 10,323,804`, calculate `AVG(Bytes ÷ Milliseconds)` for each media type name, then take the simple average of those media type averages.
queries:
SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
)

SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
    GROUP BY m.Name
)

SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes < 10323804
    GROUP BY m.Name
)

SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
  SELECT AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes <= 10323804
  GROUP BY m.Name
)
